speaker: Harrok the Unbowed
description: P36 (plan M6-M9 §5.7 the champion stage, §5.9, §5.13 boss 3): Harrok answers from the Moot's ring at the challenge stone outside its gate (world.stonehold.moot_challenge). To a giant below stage 6 he sends it away (the Moot's size gate). Otherwise he names the duel: stepping into the ring (world.area.moot_engage) begins it (MootArena); Wildheart's challenge shortens it (his record's challenge_poise_breaks). The talk ending: a stage-6 giant to whom all three powers have sworn and whom Skarn supports (saved or rebuilt) can bid him kneel - boss.harrok.outcome yielded_talk: no fight, the clan reconciled, the clans attend the crowning.

nodes.text: Go home, little giant. The Moot admits only a giant of the old height - come back when you stand at stage 6, and we will see.

So you would be king of the giants? I am Harrok the Unbowed, champion of the clans. Step into the ring, rival, and we will see whose blood the stones remember. Break me and I kneel - and then you choose whether I rise again.

choices.text: [Wildheart] I'll take you the old way, with tooth and fury.
choices.locked_text: Only a Wildheart giant can make this challenge

nodes.text: Ha! A Wildheart. Then the stones will judge us quickly - I kneel at the second time you break my guard, not the third. Into the ring!
Every power of the old kingdom has sworn to you - the March, the Greywood and the crown - and Skarn stands at your back. Even I can count, rival. What would you have of me?

choices.text: Kneel, Harrok, and let the clans crown me without blood.
choices.locked_text: The clans will not hear it yet

nodes.text: Harrok drives his axe into the earth and kneels. "The Moot is yours. Take the Stone Throne, king of giants."
Harrok kneels by the ring's gate. "The Moot is yours. Take the Stone Throne."
You broke me and let me rise. The clans will crown you - take the Stone Throne.
The challenge stone is silent. Harrok is dead, and the clans have left the Moot.
